conventions._about: Free Touch's game values to RLBot's. If Nexto drives oddly (e.g. as if upside down, or spins), try rollSign -1 or flip an angularVelocitySign, then ft_reload_content.

_kickoff: As Nexto's bot.py: a scripted speedflip at kickoffs (hardcoded_kickoffs) and looser network play until the ball is touched (stochastic_kickoffs).

difficulty._about: Per level: beta (1 = its best action, lower plays looser), reactionSeconds (it sees the ball and the other cars this late), maxSpeed (no boost on the ground above this, uu/s; 0 = no cap). A scenario's own beta can only lower it.
